# Earlier plugin-core ledger fixture

`plugin-core-bae7c4279.sql` is a SQLite `.dump` produced by the real storage adapter and
`SessionLogImpl.append` at commit `bae7c42794dbb975330983d19020c68033895ad9`.
It contains synthetic data only. The original event envelopes, anchor/chain digests and
schema are retained; the fixture is not generated by the current implementation.

Three sessions cover plain messages, tool call/result rows, and an artifact resource link.
Each also contains a request header without the later attachment omission watermark; the
attachment session includes the earlier optional request-media header. The earlier build
has no side-call event kind. The tool result and resource link are synthetic ledger inputs;
fixture generation does not execute a tool, contact a model, or upload an original file.

To reproduce, extract that revision into an isolated directory, install its frozen lockfile
with Node 24 and pnpm 10.34.5, and build `packages/host-infrastructure` with `tsc -b`.
Create a temporary SQLite storage adapter, open each session with `SessionLogImpl.open`,
and append these envelopes through the old validator. Close every log and the adapter,
then export with `sqlite3 sessions.db .dump`. Keep the old schema and integrity values.

The regression tests restore this dump into a temporary database and exercise current
verification, reducer replay, continuation and child-prefix replay. They compare all
original stored event columns after continuation and check that tampered earlier rows
still fail full chain verification.
